mission: Disambiguate root cause of 22+ BG cumulative chat-cap failure: capacity gap vs evaluator self-impossibility vs other.

logit_shape_probe.method: single forward pass, top-5 logit + softmax + entropy on 7 prompt variants
logit_shape_probe.conclusion: Mode collapse observed in greedy/sample is NOT genuine model failure — it is a SUFFIX-INDUCED decoding artifact. Prompts ending in ':' get 44-46% probability mass on ':' token. Without ':' suffix, entropy >10 (broad). Top tokens for plain Korean prompts are byte-fragments and English words — Korean coherent generation is absent.

decode_fix_probe.outcome: All 10 generations produce byte-level garbage + scattered English fragments (the, you, of, inter). NO coherent Korean output. ':' attractor escaped but underlying Korean chat capability is absent.

root_cause_classification.h_a_capacity_gap: PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED — 477M is 2x larger than prior 18M-150M BGs but still below 1B+ emergence threshold; not the dominant cause for this calibration
root_cause_classification.h_b_evaluator_self_impossibility: REJECTED — V4 evaluator was never reached; model output is sub-V4-evaluable garbage independent of evaluator strictness
root_cause_classification.h_c_sft_corpus_mismatch: CONFIRMED_DOMINANT — SFT trained on 60% anima_axis (mostly English) + 30% English academic + 10% mixed chat-template. Effective Korean conversational training: <5%. Model has near-zero Korean chat completion competence.

v4_pass_count_note: V4 evaluator not run because outputs are sub-evaluable (byte garbage). V4 pass count is structurally undefined for this stack.

lesson_q_l_reconciliation.lesson_q_status: COMPLETE_FULL_FALSIFY_INCL_OWN_20 (BG-JX, BG-JZ-FT, BG-JS, BG-JT, BG-JP all FAIL across lm_head / decoding / full-SFT / explicit-chat-template / general-corpus)
lesson_q_l_reconciliation.lesson_l_claim: #115 chat-incapability is ARCHITECTURAL — capacity 1-order jump 무관, fine-tune cannot fix
lesson_q_l_reconciliation.implication_for_bg_iy: BG-IY adds ANOTHER data point at 477M (CLM mk2-v1 + LoRA SFT) consistent with Lesson Q. Korean-heavy SFT (BG-IZ-style) is therefore PREDICTED to fail by Lesson Q before any attempt — Lesson Q already covers 'all SFT lanes including explicit chat-template corpus'. Proposing BG-IZ Korean-heavy SFT would be Lesson-Q-blind regression.
valid_post_lesson_q_paths: P1 PRE-TRAINING REDESIGN — continued-pretrain CLM on Korean conversational mass (not SFT). Lesson Q-compliant since Lesson Q only falsified fine-tune lanes.
P2 ARCH REDESIGN — Mamba/state-space (B14), MoE (B12), recurrent depth (B13) — Lesson L-compliant via architectural change.
P3 FOUNDATION BORROW — Polyglot-Ko-1.3B / Qwen2.5-3B-KR + LoRA. Lesson Q only constrains anima/CLM-native arch; an external chat-emergent foundation sidesteps the architectural ceiling.
P4 INFERENCE-COMPUTE — best-of-N + V4 ranker + self-refine on existing CLM. Lesson Q falsified training lanes only; inference-time compute is untouched.

primary.thesis: P1 — continued pre-training (NOT SFT) on CLM mk2-v1 with Korean conversational corpus (BG-HK 30MB + synthetic 50MB). Targets Lesson Q gap (pre-training was the only path Lesson Q explicitly endorsed: 'Pre-training + arch redesign required, not fine-tune').

secondary.thesis: P3 — pivot to external foundation. Polyglot-Ko-1.3B + LoRA on BG-HK 30MB. Bypasses Lesson L architectural ceiling entirely.

tertiary.thesis: P4 — best-of-64 sampling on existing CLM mk2-v1 + LoRA + V4 evaluator as ranker. Lesson Q-orthogonal lever. Tests whether top-1-of-64 ever clears V4 ≥ 7/15.
tertiary.estimated_cost: 0 (Mac MPS or H100 on existing weights)

lessons_for_roadmap_chat_cap_emergence_p: Lesson S: SFT corpus language composition is binding constraint at <500M scale. Model with English-heavy SFT cannot pass Korean V4 even at 477M.

Lesson T: Mode collapse :::: in CLM v4 chat output is decoding artifact (':' suffix attractor at p=46%), not genuine model failure. Future BG inference scripts must avoid ':'-terminated prompts and use repetition_penalty>=1.3.
Lesson U: The H_C (corpus_mismatch) hypothesis was not in the original Stage 0 expected branch set. Add it as a third disambiguation outcome alongside capacity_gap and evaluator_strict.

Naming: Lessons A-R already taken (J was skipped); BG-IY new lessons start at S to avoid collision with existing Lesson H (V2 surface metric / V3 needed) and Lesson I (BPE+early-stopping V3 hypothesis NOT_TRIGGERED).

own_29_reconcile.note: (2026-05-07-late) — SIMPLE_STACK_PASS strict floor = V4 >= 10/15 per . Original 7/15 references in this verdict interpret as PARTIAL_PASS tier, NOT SIMPLE_STACK_PASS strict.
